summary: Wheeler County, OR lookout site 18 miles east of Mitchell; listed as abandoned and gone, with a 1930s date and no source describing what remains.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Decade only: firelookout.com lists the site under '1930s: unknown'

evidence.supports: dated to the 1930s, with year unknown, and abandoned
agency listed as Oregon Dept. of Forestry
table lists a Juniper Butte lookout site
listed with unknown type and status Gone

corrections.why: The record's firelookout.com link has a stray quote mark and a second address joined to the first; the page loads at the second address

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 5531 feet and the eastern Oregon table gives 5535 feet. The difference is four feet, and the record holds no elevation.

notes_for_editor: Very thin record: two short listings and a table line. No construction, staffing, fire or current-condition source found. A different summit called Juniper Butte near Mitchell (MountainZone, 44.5354, -120.1838) was not used. The record link is malformed (see corrections). The table's '(LO site)' label was read as a lookout site, not as a standing lookout. Record status 'gone' is consistent with the FFLA list.
